information_table.unit_interpretation: Four purposively sampled ordinary common-stock rows from the SEC-indexed amendment XML independently support legacy-thousands scaling within 0.11% of same-date closes; this is not a full 806-row audit and no values are normalized.

unit_rule.rationale: Two ordinary-share rows have raw implied prices near USD 0.25-0.33, while multiplying filed values by 1,000 produces implied prices within 0.14% of same-date closes. The filing's rendered table header says nearest dollar.
unit_rule.amendment_disposition: Four SEC-indexed ordinary common-stock rows corroborate legacy-thousands scaling within 0.11%; full 806-row normalization is not yet verified and automatic rescaling remains prohibited.

implications: The Canada Life Q3 2026 base 13F table is almost certainly expressed in legacy thousands despite the post-2023 nearest-dollar rule and the rendered nearest-dollar header.
The 13F-HR/A is primary-verified as NEW HOLDINGS with 806 entries, not a restatement and not a trade tape.
The amendment's 8,531,520 summary total is consistent with the same scale issue, but the amendment information table has not been retrieved and must not be normalized yet.
Quarter-end holdings become usable only after the applicable filing is public; no position may be backdated to 2026-09-30 for a live signal.
The feed updated timestamp is metadata evidence, not a certified SEC acceptance or public-availability timestamp.
The amendment's SEC-hosted information-table XML is publicly indexed; four ordinary common-stock row samples reproduce same-date closes within 0.11% after multiplying filed values by 1,000.
The four-row amendment sample does not establish that every one of the 806 entries uses the same scale; the raw XML bytes, SHA-256 and full-table parse remain outstanding.

A secondary filing-chain source reports EDGAR acceptance at 2026-11-27T15:10:56Z, matching the SEC Atom feed updated timestamp, but the primary SEC index and first-public-availability time are not yet verified.
next_gates: Retrieve and SHA-256 hash the complete SEC amendment information-table XML and official filing index.
Parse and reconcile all 806 rows against the original Q3 2026 table by CUSIP, class, put/call, quantity, discretion and other-manager assignment.
Verify the exact parent accession and official acceptance/index clock from SEC primary records; preserve a separate first-public-availability bound.
Build a deterministic fail-closed unit detector that preserves original values and records any normalized values separately with rule version and row evidence.
Validate the detector on Canada Life, four already verified BI value-unit restatements, and a broader control sample.
Primary-verify the ten remaining BI amendments.
Continue 13D/G and FINRA gates on their existing schedules; do not duplicate or manually dispatch scheduled captures.
